description:
DCB Bank was incorporated in 1995, by reconstituting the Development Co-operative Bank Ltd (DCBL) to Development Credit Bank Ltd as a joint-stock banking company. [1]

Key Points:
Business Profile: {#https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/7e643ad2-222b-4d10-aaec-46b3c753d049.pdf#page=7# #} The company began as the Ismailia and Masalawalla co-operative banks, which merged in 1981 into the Development Co-operative Bank. After absorbing Citi Co-operative Bank, it converted into a joint- stock bank, Development Credit Bank Ltd, on May 31, 1995 [1] . It received its universal banking licence in 1995, listed on BSE and NSE through a 2006 IPO, repositioned as a retail bank focused on secured small-ticket lending in 2009, and renamed itself DCB Bank Limited in 2014 Promoted by Aga Khan Fund for Economic Development (AKFED) & Platinum Jubilee Investments Limited ( holds ~ 16.23% as of March 31, 2026 ) [2]
